_comment: Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.charlie-bot\config.json (never inside the repo) and fill in. Every value here is a placeholder.

_keys.x: X API credentials. bearer reads mentions; the four OAuth 1.0a values post replies as the bot account.
_keys.bot_user_id: The bot account's numeric X user ID (a string). Required.
_keys.rpc_urls: Mainnet RPC URLs, tried in order. Empty uses the indexer's defaults.
_keys.keypairs: Paths to the Solana key files: launch, treasury, ops. Each must be the matching legs wallet. Not read in --dry-run.
_keys.upstash: Upstash Redis REST url and token, shared with the site's /api/claim.
_keys.db: SQLite file for the Book and the ledger. Default: book.db next to this config.
_keys.log: Log file, one line per event. Default: bot.log next to this config.
